newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Kansas City Southern estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Kansas City Southern estimate cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Tuesday lowered its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Kansas City Southern Industries Inc to $2.85 from $3.20 to account for net carrying costs of its purchase of a concession to operate one of Mexico's railways.

-- Analyst Steve Lewins said Gruntal was not changing its 1998 earnings estimate of $3.50, but would deem it "tentative" until it can determine the nature of the financing of the deal and whether any "goodwill" will end up on the balance sheet of the venture between Kansas City Southern and Transportacion Maritima Mexicana SA de CV.
-- The company's stock was down 1-1/4 at 45-3/4.
